emails.subject: API documentation has incorrect example
emails.body:
Hi,

Found a bug in your API docs. On the authentication page, the example shows:

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer {token}" ...
```

But the actual header should be:

```
curl -H "X-API-Key: {token}" ...
```

Took me an hour to figure out why my requests were failing with 401.

Might want to update the docs to prevent confusion for other developers.

Cheers,
John
